tools.name: add_pet
tools.description: Add a new pet to the store with a request body. Use this when the user wants to list a brand new pet for sale.

tools.name: find_pets_by_status
tools.description: Finds pets by their status value such as available, pending, or sold. Use this when searching for pets using their availability state.

tools.name: get_pet_by_id
tools.description: Finds a single pet by its unique integer ID. Use this when you need detailed information for a specific pet.

tools.name: delete_pet
tools.description: Deletes an existing pet by ID. Use this when a pet needs to be removed from the store inventory permanently.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Returns pet inventories broken down by status. Use this to get a high-level summary of store stock levels.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place a new purchase order for a pet. Use this when a user wants to buy a pet and complete an order.

tools.name: get_order_by_id
tools.description: Find a purchase order by its unique ID. Use this to check the status or details of an existing pet order.

tools.name: delete_order
tools.description: Delete a purchase order by its ID. Use this when an existing order needs to be cancelled and removed.

tools.name: create_user
tools.description: Create a new user account in the system. Use this when registering a single new user profile.

tools.name: login_user
tools.description: Logs a user into the system using username and password credentials. Use this to authenticate a user session.

tools.name: get_user_by_name
tools.description: Retrieve user details by their username. Use this when looking up specific user profile information.

tools.name: delete_user
tools.description: Delete a user account by username. Use this to completely remove a user from the system.
